name: Felgrand Dragon
extDescription: This monster cannot be Special Summoned except from the Graveyard, and only if it was sent there from the field. When this card is Special Summoned, select 1 monster in your Graveyard. This card gains ATK equal to the Level of that monster x 200.

name: Darkblaze Dragon
extDescription: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard, its ATK and DEF increase to become twice its original ATK and DEF. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Herald of Creation
extDescription: Once per turn, you can discard 1 card from your hand to add 1 Level 7 or higher monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Decoy Dragon
extDescription: When this card is selected as an attack target by your your opponent's monster, select 1 Level 7 or higher Dragon-Type monster from your Graveyard, Special Summon it, and switch the attack to that monster.

name: Spear Cretin
extDescription: FLIP After this card is flipped, when it is sent to the Graveyard, both you and your opponent select 1 monster from your respective Graveyards and special summon it on the field in face-up Attack Position or face down in Defense Position (no Tribute is required for monsters of Level 5 or more).

name: Gilford the Lightning
extDescription: If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 3 monsters, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Morphing Jar
extDescription: FLIP: Both players discard all cards in their hands. The both players draw 5 cards.

name: Kaiser Sea Horse
extDescription: If you Tribute Summon a LIGHT monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tribute Monsters for the Tribute Summon.

name: Tyrant Dragon
extDescription: When there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field after this monster's first attack of your Battle Phase, this monster can attack once again during the same Battle Phase. In addition, negate the effect of a Trap Card that targets this card and destroy it. If this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard by another card's effect, you must Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster on your side of the field.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
extDescription: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase of the turn with 1000 ATK and 1000 DEF. You can only use this effect once per Duel.

name: Guardian Angel Joan
extDescription: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
cleanName: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
extDescription: While this card is on the field, it is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. During the End Phase of a turn that this card destroyed a monster by battle, by sending this card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.

name: Masked Dragon
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK to your side of the field from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: The Creator
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Once per turn, you can select 1 monster from your Graveyard. Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard and Special Summon the selected monster.

name: The Creator Incarnate
extDescription: By Tributing this card, Special Summon 1 "The Creator" from your hand.

name: Flame Ruler
extDescription: When Tribute Summoning a FIRE monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

name: Majestic Mech - Goryu
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card by Tributing 1 monster. If you Normal Summon it this way, it is sent to the Graveyard during the End Phase. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

name: Snipe Hunter
extDescription: Discard 1 card from your hand. Select 1 card on the field an roll a six-sided die. If the result is not 1 or 6, destroy the selected card.

name: Trade-In
extDescription: Discard 1 Level 8 monster from your hand. Draw 2 cards from your Deck.

name: Foolish Burial
extDescription: Select 1 monster from your Deck and send it to the Graveyard.

name: Soul Exchange
extDescription: Select 1 monster your opponent controls. This turn, if you would Tribute a monster you control, Tribute the selected monster instead. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase during the turn that you activate this card.

name: Giant Trunade
extDescription: Return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to their owners' hands.

name: The Shallow Grave
extDescription: Both player select 1 monster from their respective Graveyards and Special Summon them on the field in face-down Defense Position.

name: Premature Burial
extDescription: Pay 800 Life Points. Select 1 monster from your Graveyard, Special Summon it on the field in face-up Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

name: A Wingbeat of Giant Dragon
extDescription: Return to the owner's hand 1 face-up Level 5 or higher Dragon-Type monster on your side of the field and destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Big Bang Shot
extDescription: Increase the ATK of a monster equipped with this card by 400 points. When the equipped monster attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. When this card is removed from the field, remove the equipped monster from play.

name: Mystik Wok
extDescription: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field and select its ATK or DEF. Increase your Life Points by the same amount.

name: Lightning Vortex
extDescription: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all face-up monsters on your opponent's side of the field.

name: Brain Control
extDescription: Pay 800 Life Points. Select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. Take control of the selected card until the end of this turn.

name: Mausoleum of the Emperor
extDescription: Both players can Normal Summon or Set monsters without Tribute(s) by paying 1000 Life Points x the number of monsters needed to Tribute Summon them.

name: Malevolent Catastrophe
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent's monster declares an attack. Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on your opponent's side of the field. You can then Set 1 Spell or Trap Card from your hand.

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Select 1 monster from your Graveyard and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. When this card is removed from the field, destroy the monster. When the monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Magic Jammer
extDescription: Discard 1 card. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

name: Sakuretsu Armor
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack. Destroy the attacking monster.

name: Draining Shield
extDescription: Negate the attack of 1 of your opponent's monsters and increase your Life Points by the attacking monster's ATK.
